meta.title: Device RKP Issuer
meta.description: Sign a P-256 key with this device's KeyMint TA and get an RKP certificate chain from Google, exported as keybox.xml.
meta.warning: This only works on some devices and only issues RKP certificates. It uses a private Qualcomm KeyMint ABI that may differ across firmware. An incompatible ABI can crash the worker or trusted app. The exported keybox contains a software-generated private key; keep the files private. Read the prerequisites before continuing.

limitations.partial_device_support: Only some devices work. Qualcomm KeyMint firmware, root access, /dev/smcinvoke and libkeymasterdeviceutils.so are all required, but even then the vendor ABI may differ.
limitations.rkp_only: Only RKP certificates can be issued. A compatible device is required to obtain the signed CSR. The exported private key is generated in software; no private key is extracted from the TEE.

status.title: Prerequisites
status.description: Checked locally without sending anything to KeyMint or to a server.

blockers.android_arm64_required: This build must run on Android arm64.
blockers.root_required: Root access is required to reach the KeyMint trusted app.
blockers.qualcomm_soc_required: A non-Qualcomm SoC vendor was identified; this operation requires Qualcomm KeyMint.
blockers.fingerprint_missing: The build fingerprint is missing, so the server cannot bind a challenge.
blockers.soc_vendor_unknown: The SoC vendor could not be identified from local properties or kernel information.
blockers.soc_vendor_conflict: Local SoC information conflicts. Review the detection evidence before continuing.

run.blocked: Resolve the missing prerequisites above before issuing.
run.title: Result
run.backup: The previous file was backed up to {path}.
run.onlyRkpHint: The chain was signed by Google for the key in the keybox file. Keep the private key file: without it the keybox is unusable.

confirm.title: Send a request to the KeyMint TA?
confirm.body: This runs CSR_V2 on the device's Qualcomm KeyMint trusted app and submits the result to Google. It only works on some devices and only RKP certificates can be issued. The exported files contain a private key; keep them private. Continue?

errors.unsupported_device: This device does not meet the prerequisites.
errors.ta_timeout: The KeyMint trusted app did not answer in time.
errors.ta_transport_error: Talking to the KeyMint trusted app failed; the firmware ABI may be incompatible.
errors.ta_rejected: The KeyMint trusted app rejected the request.
errors.invalid_ta_response: The KeyMint trusted app returned a malformed response.
errors.invalid_device_csr: The CSR returned by the device failed validation.
errors.certificate_key_mismatch: The issued certificate does not match the generated key.
errors.invalid_server_url: The provisioning server URL is invalid.
errors.unsupported_eek_curve: The server returned an unsupported EEK curve.
errors.invalid_rkp_response: The RKP server response is invalid.
errors.device_not_registered: The RKP server does not recognise this device.
errors.rkp_client_error: The RKP server rejected the request.
